MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 16
   C. 55
   D. 32

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 49

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 75
   D. 20

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)

   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

13. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 32
   C. 9
   D. 64

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)

   D. 31

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)

   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

20. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 18

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 33

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 18
   C. 30
   D. 36

23. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 8
   D. 9

24. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4
